name: clinicflow
description: ClinicFlow — clinic management system for small medical clinics

scripts.build: npm run build -w @clinic/shared && npm run build -w @clinic/api && npm run build -w @clinic/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @clinic/api" "npm run dev -w @clinic/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @clinic/shared && npm run lint -w @clinic/api && npm run lint -w @clinic/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clinic/shared && npm run typecheck -w @clinic/api && npm run typecheck -w @clinic/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @clinic/api && npm run test -w @clinic/web
